item.title: Bruce Street Closure
item.description: Bruce Street will be closed to thru traffic from Elizabeth Street to Donaghey Avenue from Tuesday, March 3 through Friday, March 6 for infrastructure upgrades.

item.title: Cancelation of Evening Classes and Early Closures
item.description: Evening classes for Monday, January 30, are canceled. This includes all classes with start times of 5 p.m. or later. Faculty will communicate with students regarding any virtual assignments and/or adjustments to the syllabus and course schedule.
